PAKISTAN LEGAL PRACTITIONERS AND BAR COUNCILS (AMENDMENT) RULES, 1984
PAKISTAN LEGAL
PRACTITIONERS AND BAR COUNCILS (AMENDMENT) RULES, 1984
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, 30th July, 1984]
S. R. O. 677 (1)/84.---In
exercise of the powers conferred by section 55 of the Legal Practitioners and
Bar Council Act, 1973, and all other enabling provisions in this behalf, the
Pakistan Bar Council makes the following amendments in the "Pakistan Legal
Practitioners and Bar Councils Rules, 1976
1. Short title and
commencement.---(a) These Rules may be called the "Pakistan Legal Practitioners
and Bar Councils (Amendment) Rules, 1984."
(b) They will come into force at
once.
2. Amendment of Rule 107.---(a)
The following be added after the existing clause (ii) of sub-rule (c) of Rule
107:
"and his
name is still borne on the Roll of Advocates maintained by that Bar Council ;
he is not in arrears of dues of that Council ; and that he was not convicted
for an offence of professional and other misconduct together with details of
any case of professional or other misconduct if pending before such Provincial
Bar Council."
(b) Clause (iii)
of sub-rule (c) of rule 107 be substituted by the fol lowing :-
"(iii) A
Certificate from the High Court concerned that he is a fit and proper person to
appear and plead as an Advocate before the Supreme Court of Pakistan."
(c) The
following be added at the end of existing clause (iv) of sub -rule (c) of rule
107,--
"and that
he was not convicted for an offence of professional or other misconduct and no
such case is pending before any Bar Council."
(d) The
following new clauses (v), (vi) and (vii) be added after the existing clause
(iv) of sub-rule (c) of rule 107 :-
"(v) a
certificate from the Bar Association of which he is a Member to the effect that
he is not in arrears of subscription or any other dues of the Bar Association.
(vi) a list of
selected cases conducted by the applicant in the High Court.
(vii) two
passport size photographs of the applicant duly attested by the
President/Secretary of the Bar Association of which he is a Member or by any
Member of a Bar Council."
3. Amendment of Form `C' attached
to the Rules under rule 108(c) :-
The existing Form `C' be
substituted by the following : -
"FORM 'C'
[See rule 108 (c)]
(Certificate for permission to
appear, act and plead as an Advocate of the Supreme Court of Pakistan).
The Pakistan Bar Council hereby
certifies that Mr. ------------------- S/o --------------- resident of
--------------- being an Advocate who satisfies all the conditions laid down by
Rules framed by the Supreme Court of Pakistan has this -------------- day of
---------------19 ------------- been admitted and enrolled as an Advocate of
the Supreme Court of Pakistan subject to his signing the Roll of Advocates
being maintained by the Supreme Court.
Given under the common seal of
the Pakistan Bar Council this --------------- day of -------------
19----------.
THE FREE LEGAL AID SCHEME
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, 30th July, 1984]
S. R. O. 678 (1)/84.---Whereas
it is expedient in the interest of justice to provide free legal aid to the
deserving litigant persons, the Pakistan Bar Council, in exercise of powers
conferred by section 13 of the Legal Practi tioners and Bar Councils Act, 1973
(Act XXXV of 1973) and other enabling provisions in this behalf hereby makes and
promulgates the following scheme :--
1. Short title and
commencement.---(a) This scheme shall be known as "The Free Legal Aid
Scheme."
(b) It shall
come into force at once.
2. Object of the Scheme.---This
scheme shall provide free legal aid to the deserving persons and the
beneficiaries under the scheme shall be the poor and destitute, orphans,
widows, and invalid persons in the following cases :-
(a) Accidents
(b) Succession
certificate cases.
(c) Cases
relating to family Laws.
(d) Ejectment cases.
(e) Preventive
detention cases ; and
(f) Other cases
which the Committee, thinks fit and expedient for extending free
